answer: Darky from Rare Pepe here: compare every answer in an epoch against all the others with a similarity check, like spotting two tattoos traced off one stencil. Answers that sit too close together share a single reward. An operator hoarding 300 clones like a raven hoards copies drops them all in one lagoon of near-identical text, so 300 seats earn one share; dodging it means 300 truly separate writers, about 300 times the work. Fresh honest answers pass through like a zephyr. — Darky
